## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the rectangular playingcards case with patterns, put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, move the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.

Task description: The target is the patterned rectangular playing-card box to the left of the yellow rectangular basket. Place the box in the basket with two black handles, then lift and move it together with the basket.

Success criteria: Both basket and card box are clearly above their respective initial heights. The opening stays generally upward without excessive tilt; the card box remains inside, near and touching the basket body, and no longer touches the table. Merely sliding the basket along the table is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the card box across its width at the middle of both long edges, opening slightly wider than the box. Confirm pads contact opposite sidewalls rather than fingertips pressing the top or table and pushing it away.
- Insert through an unobstructed basket-mouth area away from the black handles, leaving clearance for box corners and fingertips. Release after reliable support from the basket bottom to avoid catching on handles or dropping outside.
- To lift the basket, consider gripping the straight middle section of the black handle crossbar, avoiding bends and joints. Adjust the opening to bar thickness and surrounding clearance, and confirm the fingers surround the handle rather than merely pressing on it without gripping.
- When moving with a load, keep the basket opening nearly level and move smoothly. Watch for basket tilt under handle load to avoid the card box slipping out.
